steps.content: The medical bay isn't far away, but she slows her pace, her steps steady, knowing what you're going through.
Shin holds you in her arms, afraid of startling you in your nightmare.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=36>So many eyes... limbs... I can't see...</size></color>
Your eyes are screwed shut as you relive the nightmare, instinctively curling into her embrace and clutching at her clothes.
Your body is cold, your clothes drenched in cold sweat, but Shin doesn't flinch. She only holds you tighter.
You feel yourself sinking into a warm, soft embrace in the darkness.
The hands supporting your shoulders pat you gently, calming you down.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: It's okay now. You did well...
She stops outside the medical bay. In the empty corridor, she buries her face against your frail shoulder and takes a deep breath.
You feel something wet land on your cheek. You can't tell if it's rain, water, or a tear.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Hah... You made it — very well.
